label: Scaled dot-product attention: Attention of Q K V equals softmax of Q times K transpose divided by the square root of d-k times V
The softmax: each attention weight alpha sub j equals e to the power s sub j divided by the sum over all i of e to the power s sub i — every weight is positive and all weights sum to 1
The attention output for one query: the weighted sum o equals the sum over j of alpha sub j times v sub j — each token gathers its context as a weighted mix of the value vectors

Temperature scaling: the raw score s sub j equals the dot product of q and k sub j divided by the square root of d times the temperature T — smaller T sharpens the weights toward a single token and larger T flattens them toward uniform
Multi-head attention: MultiHead of Q K V equals the concatenation of heads of attention with per-head projections W q W k W v followed by a final projection W o
